command:
set -eu
sudo sh -c '
set -eu
umask 077
node_ip=$1
credential=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
test ${#credential} -eq 64
digest=$(printf "%s" "$credential" | openssl dgst -sha256)
password_hash=[REDACTED] }
test ${#password_hash} -eq 64
env_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/.redis-inventory.env.XXXXXX)
printf "REDIS_HOST=%s\nREDIS_PORT=6379\nREDIS_USER=inventory\nREDIS_USERNAME=inventory\nREDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED] "$node_ip" "$credential" > "$env_tmp"
chown root:root "$env_tmp"
chmod 600 "$env_tmp"
mv -f "$env_tmp" /etc/redis-inventory.env
acl_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/redis/.users.acl.XXXXXX)
printf "user default off\nuser inventory on #%s ~* &* +@all\n" "$password_hash" > "$acl_tmp"
chown root:redis "$acl_tmp"
chmod 640 "$acl_tmp"
mv -f "$acl_tmp" /etc/redis/users.acl
conf_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/redis/.inventory.conf.XXXXXX)
printf "bind 127.0.0.1 %s\nprotected-mode yes\naclfile /etc/redis/users.acl\ndir /var/lib/redis\ndbfilename dump.rdb\nsave 3600 1 300 100 60 10000\nappendonly yes\nappendfilename appendonly.aof\nappenddirname appendonlydir\nappendfsync everysec\naof-use-rdb-preamble yes\n" "$node_ip" > "$conf_tmp"
chown redis:root "$conf_tmp"
chmod 640 "$conf_tmp"
mv -f "$conf_tmp" /etc/redis/inventory.conf
if ! grep -Fqx "include /etc/redis/inventory.conf" /etc/redis/redis.conf; then
  printf "\ninclude /etc/redis/inventory.conf\n" >> /etc/redis/redis.conf
fi
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon -F /etc/redis-inventory.env /etc/redis/users.acl /etc/redis/inventory.conf /etc/redis/redis.conf; fi
' sh "$NODE_IP"

sudo awk -F= '$1 != "REDIS_PASSWORD" {print}' /etc/redis-inventory.env

sudo grep -E '^(bind|protected-mode|aclfile|dir|dbfilename|save|appendonly|appendfilename|appenddirname|appendfsync|aof-use-rdb-preamble)' /etc/redis/inventory.conf
